ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a surface and horizon landscape similar to a desert, and two bright dots can be seen in the sky at the same time, shown as two suns appearing in the same sky at the same time. Reasoning: The material explains that this planet orbits two stars, and the planet and the two stars are almost in the same plane; the distance between the two stars is very close. Because the two stars are close to each other, their apparent positions and rising and setting paths in the sky of this planet may be very close, so on a certain day, the two suns may set below the horizon almost at the same time. In this way, that day may appear as one sunset. Therefore the answer is 1 time.
